inlines.text: 黄仁勋辞职
执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 被任命为临时首席执行官
Harvey C. Jones 被任命为首位董事会主席

blocks.text: NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务，即刻生效。

inlines.text: NVIDIA（纳斯达克股票代码：NVDA）董事会今日宣布，黄仁勋已辞去总裁、首席执行官及董事会成员职务，即刻生效。

blocks.text: NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意出任临时首席执行官。在正式继任者确定之前，Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时履行临时首席执行官职责。董事会已启动正式首席执行官的遴选工作，将同时考虑内部和外部候选人。

inlines.text: NVIDIA 现任执行副总裁兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 已同意出任临时首席执行官。在正式继任者确定之前，Kress 将继续担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官，同时履行临时首席执行官职责。董事会已启动正式首席执行官的遴选工作，将同时考虑内部和外部候选人。

blocks.text: Kress 自 2013 年 9 月加入 NVIDIA 以来一直担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官。任职期间，她领导公司的财务组织，在 NVIDIA 的成长与演进中发挥了关键作用。加入 NVIDIA 之前，Kress 在思科、微软等领先科技公司从事财务工作近 25 年。

inlines.text: Kress 自 2013 年 9 月加入 NVIDIA 以来一直担任执行副总裁兼首席财务官。任职期间，她领导公司的财务组织，在 NVIDIA 的成长与演进中发挥了关键作用。加入 NVIDIA 之前，Kress 在思科、微软等领先科技公司从事财务工作近 25 年。

blocks.text: 董事会任命 Harvey C. Jones 为首位董事会主席。Jones 先生拥有 30 多年的企业家、技术高管和活跃风险投资人经历，曾担任 Synopsys 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

inlines.text: 董事会任命 Harvey C. Jones 为首位董事会主席。Jones 先生拥有 30 多年的企业家、技术高管和活跃风险投资人经历，曾担任 Synopsys 首席执行官兼执行董事长。

blocks.text: NVIDIA 董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“Colette 协助带领 NVIDIA 走过了一段非凡的增长期，对我们的业务、客户、运营和财务状况有着深刻理解。她得到了一支经验丰富的领导团队的支持，这支团队在落实 NVIDIA 战略、推进技术路线图方面发挥了重要作用。董事会对 Colette 和领导团队充满信心，我们预计公司的运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将继续不受影响。”

inlines.text: NVIDIA 董事会主席 Harvey Jones 表示：“Colette 协助带领 NVIDIA 走过了一段非凡的增长期，对我们的业务、客户、运营和财务状况有着深刻理解。她得到了一支经验丰富的领导团队的支持，这支团队在落实 NVIDIA 战略、推进技术路线图方面发挥了重要作用。董事会对 Colette 和领导团队充满信心，我们预计公司的运营、客户承诺和产品路线图将继续不受影响。”

blocks.text: NVIDIA 临时首席执行官兼首席财务官 Colette Kress 表示：“NVIDIA 的力量始终来自员工。我将与领导团队一道，致力于在黄仁勋过去 33 年打下的非凡基础上继续前进。我们将继续推进让 NVIDIA 成为加速计算和 AI 领域领导者的工作，并把握未来的机遇。我们的重心仍然是服务客户、合作伙伴、开发者和股东。”

Jensen Huang Resigns
Colette Kress, Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer, Appointed Interim CEO
Harvey C. Jones Appointed First-Ever Chair of the Board

blocks.text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

inlines.text: NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) Board of Directors announced today that Jensen Huang has resigned as President, Chief Executive Officer, and a member of the Board, effective immediately.

blocks.text: Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates.

inlines.text: Colette Kress, current Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA, has agreed to serve as Interim Chief Executive Officer. Kress will continue to serve as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer while serving as Interim Chief Executive Officer until a permanent successor has been named. The Board is initiating a search for a permanent Chief Executive Officer and will consider internal and external candidates.

blocks.text: Kress has served as Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of NVIDIA since joining the company in September 2013. During her tenure, she has led the company’s finance organization and has played a key role in NVIDIA’s growth and evolution. Prior to joining NVIDIA, Kress spent nearly 25 years in finance roles at leading technology companies, including Cisco and Microsoft.

blocks.text: The Board of Directors appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board. Mr. Jones has been an entrepreneur, technology executive, and active venture investor for over 30 years, including serving as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

inlines.text: The Board of Directors appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first-ever Chair of the Board. Mr. Jones has been an entrepreneur, technology executive, and active venture investor for over 30 years, including serving as Chief Executive Officer and Executive Chairman of Synopsys.

blocks.text: “Colette has helped lead NVIDIA through a period of extraordinary growth and has a deep understanding of our business, customers, operations and financial position,” said Harvey Jones, Chair of the NVIDIA Board of Directors. “She is supported by an experienced leadership team that has been instrumental in executing NVIDIA’s strategy and advancing its technology roadmap. The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company’s operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption.”

The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team, and we expect the company’s operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption.”

blocks.text: “NVIDIA’s strength has always come from its people, and together with our leadership team, I am committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years,” said Colette Kress, Interim CEO and CFO, NVIDIA. “We will continue advancing the work that has made NVIDIA a leader in accelerated computing and AI, and execute on the opportunities ahead. Our focus remains on serving our customers, partners, developers and shareholders.”
